profile_text.body:
Cartesia is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its website describes the company as building AI that learns and interacts like humans, and says its team has pioneered AI architectures including state space models (SSMs), Mamba and H-Nets.

The company's stated product is Sonic-3.6, a streaming text-to-speech API for real-time speech generation. Cartesia says the system produces natural, expressive voices, including laughter, across 44 languages, and that it is built for AI agents and interactive apps. The site frames this work as the practical result of the company's research mission, which it describes as architecting AI that learns from and interacts with the world the way humans do.

No lawsuits involving the company are on record, and no MCP servers from the company are listed.
